name: Godrej Reserve
description: Godrej Reserve is a resort-inspired high-rise development on Akurli Road in Kandivali East, opposite Growel's 101. The site was once a gaushala with mature tree cover, and the towers now sit around about 6 acres of landscaping over two levels, laid out as four themed zones: Forest Retreat, Tropical Oasis, Spring Terraces, and Green Acres.
curation: 9.5 ft floor-to-ceiling heights, with 6 apartments per floor in Towers 1 and 2
Tower 2 is the only tower still offering 4 BHK, and it faces a 3.5-acre amenity zone
Akurli and Poisar Metro stations on Line 7 are about 2 minutes away
amenities: About 6 acres of landscaping over two levels
connectivity: On Akurli Road, opposite Growel's 101 Mall
Akurli and Poisar Metro (Line 7) about 2 minutes
Parallel to the Western Express Highway
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Resort-style towers rising over layered landscaped gardens
